name: Al-Fashaga district
parties: Sudan (controls most since 2020); Ethiopia (Amhara farmers and militia)
origin: 1902 Anglo-Ethiopian treaty line was never demarcated on the ground; a 2008 compromise broke down in 2020.
on_the_ground: Sudanese army holds most of it; farmland with armed clashes.

name: Abyei Area
origin: Special administrative status under the 2005 Comprehensive Peace Agreement; the promised referendum was never held after South Sudan's 2011 independence.
on_the_ground: Neither state fully administers it; UN force UNISFA deployed since 2011; local Ngok Dinka administration.

name: Kafia Kingi enclave
origin: Transferred north of the 1 January 1956 line to Darfur in 1960; South Sudan claims it under the 2005 CPA rule.
on_the_ground: Sudan controls most of it; largely Radom National Park; remote and insecure.

name: Heglig (Panthou) oil field area
origin: Position of the 1956 north-south line disputed after 2011; South Sudan briefly took it in April 2012.
on_the_ground: Sudan runs it as part of West/South Kordofan; oil installations.

name: 14-Mile Area, Jodha, Kaka, Jebel Megeinis, Bebnis
origin: Segments of the 1 January 1956 line left undetermined at South Sudan's independence in 2011.
on_the_ground: Mixed local control; a 2012 agreement foresaw a demilitarised border zone that was only partly implemented.

name: Banc du Geyser
parties: France (claims as part of Scattered Islands); Madagascar; Comoros
origin: Drying reef claimed by Madagascar in 1976 and by France and Comoros.
on_the_ground: No permanent land or presence; reef mostly awash.

name: Bassas da India, Europa Island, Juan de Nova Island
origin: Detached from Madagascar by France before independence in 1960; Madagascar has claimed them since the 1970s.
on_the_ground: French military detachments and nature reserve; no civilians.

name: Glorioso Islands
origin: Retained by France at Madagascar's independence in 1960.
on_the_ground: French detachment and weather station; nature reserve.

name: Tromelin Island
origin: Mauritius has claimed it since 1976; a 2010 co-management agreement was never ratified by France.
on_the_ground: French weather station staff only.

name: Ceuta
origin: Spanish since 1668 treaty (held from 1580); Morocco has claimed it since independence in 1956.
on_the_ground: Ordinary Spanish autonomous city, EU territory with a fenced land border.

name: Melilla
origin: Spanish since 1497; claimed by Morocco since 1956.
on_the_ground: Ordinary Spanish autonomous city with a fenced land border.

name: Peñón de Vélez de la Gomera
origin: Spanish fortress since 1564; joined to the Moroccan shore by a sand isthmus since 1934.
on_the_ground: Spanish army garrison only; has a short land border on the beach.

name: Peñón de Alhucemas and islets
origin: Spanish since 1673.
on_the_ground: Spanish army garrison only.

name: Chafarinas Islands
origin: Occupied by Spain in 1848.
on_the_ground: Spanish garrison and a biological station.

name: Perejil (Leila) Island
origin: Both claim it; after a 2002 armed incident both agreed to return to the status quo of leaving it unoccupied.
on_the_ground: Deserted islet, no presence by either side.

name: Chagos Archipelago (British Indian Ocean Territory)
parties: United Kingdom (administers); Mauritius (claims; cession treaty signed 22 May 2025, not ratified as of April 2026); Maldives (objects)
origin: Detached from Mauritius in 1965 before independence; population removed 1967-1973; ICJ advisory opinion 2019 against the UK.
on_the_ground: UK territory with no civilians outside the Diego Garcia base; outer atolls reachable only by permitted yachts.

name: Diego Garcia base
origin: UK made the island available to the US by a 1966 exchange of notes; the 2025 UK-Mauritius treaty would lease it back for 99 years.
on_the_ground: Joint UK-US military base; no civilian access.

name: Ras Doumeira and Doumeira Island
origin: Conflicting colonial texts of 1900 and 1935; armed clash in 2008; Qatari peacekeepers left in 2017.
on_the_ground: Eritrean troops hold the cape and island.

name: Guinea-Liberia border at the Makona River (Sorlumba, Foya District)
origin: Disagreement over the river boundary flared in March 2026 when Guinean soldiers crossed near Sorlumba.
on_the_ground: Riverbank locality with reported Guinean military presence; talks under ECOWAS.

name: Hala'ib Triangle
origin: 1899 political boundary (22nd parallel) versus 1902 administrative boundary; Egypt took full control in the 1990s.
on_the_ground: Run as ordinary Egyptian territory (Red Sea Governorate) with checkpoints.

name: Bir Tawil
parties: none (Egypt and Sudan each attribute it to the other)
origin: Same 1899/1902 discrepancy as Hala'ib; each state asserts the line that gives it Hala'ib, leaving Bir Tawil unclaimed.
on_the_ground: No state administration; nomads and informal gold miners.

name: Wadi Halfa Salient
origin: Small 1899/1902 discrepancy on the Nile north of the 22nd parallel.
on_the_ground: Mostly flooded by Lake Nasser/Nubia since the 1960s; current control not verified.

name: Migingo Island and nearby Lake Victoria islets
origin: Dispute since 2004-2008 over where the 1926 colonial lake boundary runs relative to the rock.
on_the_ground: Crowded fishing settlement with both Kenyan and Ugandan police present.

name: Ilemi Triangle
origin: Several colonial patrol lines (1914, 1938, 1947, 1950) and no final treaty line; Kenya has administered it since colonial times.
on_the_ground: Kenyan police posts; Turkana and other pastoralists; no visible border.

name: KaNgwane and Ingwavuma
origin: Eswatini claims land it says was taken in colonial times; a 1982 transfer plan was abandoned.
on_the_ground: Ordinary parts of Mpumalanga and KwaZulu-Natal.

name: Koalou (Kourou) neutral zone
origin: Disputed since independence; in 2008 both removed symbols of sovereignty and since 2009 a joint committee manages it pending settlement.
on_the_ground: Three villages under joint management; security presence of both states is limited and the area is insecure.

name: Kpéaba village area
origin: Undemarcated border section; Guinean troops occupied the village in 2013 and an incident followed in 2016.
on_the_ground: Ivorian-administered village.

name: Logoba / Moyo-Kajo Keji border area
origin: 1914 colonial order defined the border by tribal limits and it was never demarcated; clashes in 2014.
on_the_ground: Farmland used by both communities.

name: Lunkinda (Lunchinda) - Pweto triangle near Chiengi
origin: Different readings of an 1894 colonial treaty; incidents in 1996, 2006 and later.
on_the_ground: Congolese-administered villages on the right bank of the Lunkinda.

name: Mayotte
origin: Voted to stay French in 1974/1976 when the rest of Comoros became independent; French department since 2011.
on_the_ground: Ordinary French overseas department, EU outermost region.

name: Islands in Mbamba Bay and eastern Lake Nyasa/Malawi
parties: Tanzania (administers); Malawi (claims the whole lake to the shore)
origin: 1890 Anglo-German treaty put the border on the Tanzanian shore; Tanzania argues for the median line.
on_the_ground: Tanzanian-administered shore islets; fishing.

name: Islands in the Congo River
parties: Republic of the Congo; DR Congo
origin: The boundary in the river was never defined except in Pool Malebo.
on_the_ground: Islands used by fishers from both banks; attribution undefined.

name: Island at the mouth of the Ntem River
origin: Sovereignty over an island at the river mouth is contested.

name: Villages near the Okpara River
origin: Undemarcated river boundary section.

name: Sabanerwa and the Rufunzo Valley
origin: The Akanyaru River changed course in 1965, moving farmland to the other bank.
on_the_ground: Farmed hill area.

name: Rukwanzi Island (Lake Albert) and Semliki River valley
origin: River course shifts and unclear lake boundary; deadly incident in 2007 linked to oil exploration.
on_the_ground: Fishing settlement on the island.

name: Margherita Peak (Rwenzori)
origin: DR Congo claims the summit; Uganda treats it as a point on the boundary divide.
on_the_ground: Glaciated summit climbed from both sides.

name: Sindabezi Island
origin: Island in the Zambezi above Victoria Falls; river boundary attribution contested.
on_the_ground: Tourist lodge run from the Zambian side.

name: Orange River boundary
parties: Namibia (claims median line); South Africa (claims north bank)
origin: 1890 treaty put the border on the north bank; a 1994 surveyors' agreement on the middle was never ratified.
on_the_ground: River islands and bank used by both sides; no visible difference.

name: Yenga
origin: Guinean troops entered in 1998-2001 during Sierra Leone's civil war and stayed; Guinea has acknowledged Sierra Leone's title but disputes the Makona riverbank line.
on_the_ground: Small village with intermittent Guinean military presence.

name: La Güera and the western side of Ras Nouadhibou
parties: Mauritania (de facto control); Morocco and SADR (claim as Western Sahara)
origin: Mauritania kept a presence after withdrawing from Western Sahara in 1979; it lies south of the Moroccan wall.
on_the_ground: Abandoned ghost town watched by Mauritanian troops.

name: Western Sahara west of the berm
origin: Spain withdrew in 1975; Morocco took control 1975-1979; UN lists it as a non-self-governing territory.
on_the_ground: Run as ordinary Moroccan provinces; entered freely from Morocco.

name: Western Sahara east of the berm (Free Zone)
origin: Left under Polisario control by the 1991 ceasefire, which collapsed in November 2020.
on_the_ground: Sparsely populated desert behind a mined sand wall; UN (MINURSO) buffer strip along the berm.

name: Somaliland
origin: Declared independence in 1991 within the borders of former British Somaliland; Israel recognised it in December 2025.
on_the_ground: Own government, visa, currency and border posts.

name: Sool, Sanaag and Cayn (SSC-Khatumo / North Eastern State)
parties: Somalia's North Eastern State and Puntland (control most); Somaliland (claims)
origin: Contested between Somaliland and Puntland since 1998; Somaliland lost Las Anod in 2023.
on_the_ground: Administered by Somalia-aligned local authorities; front line with Somaliland.

name: Ethiopia-Somalia provisional administrative line
origin: The southern part of the border is a provisional administrative line left by the British in 1950 and never delimited by treaty.
on_the_ground: Pastoral borderland with no demarcation.

name: South-eastern Algeria claimed on Libyan maps
origin: Dormant Libyan claim still shown on its maps.
on_the_ground: Ordinary Algerian Saharan territory.

name: Tummo region
origin: Dormant Libyan claim in the Tummo region.
on_the_ground: Remote Saharan frontier.

name: Burkina Faso-Niger border sectors
origin: ICJ judgment of 2013; implemented 2015-2016 by exchanging 18 towns.
on_the_ground: Line now fixed.

name: Badme
origin: Awarded to Eritrea by the boundary commission in 2002; Ethiopia accepted the award in the 2018 peace declaration.
on_the_ground: Under Eritrean control since the 2020-2022 Tigray war; demarcation never completed.

name: Situngu Island
origin: Chobe River island disputed since the 1970s; a boundary treaty of 5 February 2018 left it with Botswana.

name: Mbanié, Cocotiers and Conga islands
origin: Gabon occupied the islets in 1972; the ICJ ruled in May 2025 that they belong to Equatorial Guinea.
on_the_ground: Handover status not verified.

name: Bajo Nuevo Bank
origin: US claim under the 1856 Guano Islands Act; ICJ confirmed Colombian sovereignty against Nicaragua in 2012.
on_the_ground: Uninhabited cays with a Colombian lighthouse.

name: Serranilla Bank
origin: US Guano Islands Act claim; ICJ 2012 confirmed Colombian sovereignty against Nicaragua.
on_the_ground: Small Colombian naval detachment on Beacon Cay.

name: Conejo Island
origin: Not mentioned in the 1992 ICJ judgment on the Gulf of Fonseca; Honduras has garrisoned it since the 1980s.
on_the_ground: Honduran military post on an islet 600 m off the Honduran shore.

name: Navassa Island
origin: US claimed it in 1857 under the Guano Islands Act; Haiti claims it in its constitution.
on_the_ground: Uninhabited US wildlife refuge; Haitian fishers camp there.

name: Sapodilla Cayes
origin: Claimed in Honduras's 1982 constitution and by Guatemala as part of its Belize claim; before the ICJ.
on_the_ground: Belizean marine reserve with tourist visits and a coast guard post.

name: Belize south of the Sibun River (and Belize as a whole)
origin: Guatemala treats the 1859 Wyke-Aycinena Treaty as void; both states referred the claim to the ICJ after referendums in 2018-2019.
on_the_ground: Ordinary Belizean territory; an OAS-monitored adjacency zone runs along the border.

name: Machias Seal Island and North Rock
origin: Ambiguity in the 1783 Treaty of Paris; left out of the 1984 Gulf of Maine case.
on_the_ground: Canadian lighthouse keepers; limited puffin-watching landings from both countries.

name: Guantanamo Bay Naval Base
parties: United States (leaseholder); Cuba (sovereign, rejects the lease)
origin: Perpetual lease under 1903 and 1934 treaties; Cuba has protested since 1959.
on_the_ground: US military jurisdiction behind a fenced, mined perimeter.

name: Guayana Esequiba (Guyana west of the Essequibo River)
origin: Venezuela declared the 1899 arbitral award void in 1962; case pending at the ICJ; Venezuela legislated a state there in 2024.
on_the_ground: Ordinary Guyanese regions.

name: Ankoko Island
parties: Venezuela (occupies whole island); Guyana (claims eastern half)
origin: Venezuelan troops occupied the Guyanese half in 1966.
on_the_ground: Venezuelan military post and airstrip.

name: Rincón de Artigas (Arroyo de la Invernada) and Vila Albornoz
origin: Uruguay argues since 1934 that the 1851 treaty demarcation picked the wrong stream as the Invernada.
on_the_ground: Ordinary Brazilian rural territory; open dry border nearby at Masoller.

name: Brazilian Island (Ilha Brasileira)
origin: Disagreement whether the island lies in the Quaraí mouth or in the Uruguay River; affects the tripoint with Argentina.
on_the_ground: Uninhabited river island.

name: Falkland Islands (Malvinas)
origin: British administration since 1833; war in 1982; claimed in Argentina's constitution.
on_the_ground: Self-governing UK overseas territory.

name: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
origin: Argentine claims date from 1927 and 1938; occupied briefly in 1982.
on_the_ground: UK overseas territory with only officials and scientists; visits by expedition ship.

name: Marouini-Litani area (Lawa headwaters)
origin: Dispute over which tributary (Litani or Marouini) is the upper Lawa under 19th-century arbitration.
on_the_ground: Rainforest with very few inhabitants; French administration.

name: New River Triangle (Tigri)
origin: Dispute over which river (Kutari or New River) is the source of the Courantyne; Guyana expelled a Surinamese post in 1969.
on_the_ground: Rainforest with a Guyanese army post (Camp Jaguar).

name: Isla Suárez (Ilha de Guajará-Mirim)
origin: The 1958 Roboré Accord left it under Bolivian administration without settling sovereignty.
on_the_ground: River island between Guayaramerín and Guajará-Mirim.

name: Southern Patagonian Ice Field (Fitz Roy - Cerro Murallón section)
origin: The 1998 agreement left this section undrawn pending joint mapping.
on_the_ground: Glacier with no administration; both countries' maps differ.

name: Santa Rosa Island (Amazon River)
origin: The island emerged around 1970, after the treaty line was fixed on the deepest channel; Colombia objected in 2025 when Peru created a district there.
on_the_ground: Peruvian town opposite Leticia and Tabatinga, visited freely by boat.

name: Land triangle at Punto Concordia
origin: Disagreement whether the land border starts at Hito 1 or at Punto Concordia, left open by the 2014 ICJ maritime judgment.
on_the_ground: Empty strip of beach with no access.

name: Tiwinza
origin: The 1998 Brasilia peace accords gave Ecuador private ownership without sovereignty of the 1995 battle site.
on_the_ground: Memorial site inside Peru reached by a corridor from Ecuador.

name: Aves Island (Bird Island)
parties: Venezuela (administers); neighbours contest its status as an island, not sovereignty
origin: Dominica dropped its claim in 2006; Caribbean states dispute whether it generates an EEZ.
on_the_ground: Venezuelan naval research station on stilts.

name: Hans Island (Tartupaluk)
origin: Left out of the 1973 boundary treaty; divided along a natural ravine by agreement of 14 June 2022.
on_the_ground: Uninhabited rock now crossed by a land border.

name: Isla Portillos / Isla Calero northern tip
origin: Nicaraguan troops entered in 2010; ICJ judgments of 2015 and 2018 confirmed Costa Rican sovereignty except Harbour Head Lagoon.
on_the_ground: Uninhabited wetland.

name: Oyster Pond (Saint Martin)
origin: Lagoon boundary disputed in 2016; agreement of 2023 splits the bay down the middle, not yet in force as of mid-2026.
on_the_ground: Marina area on an open border.

name: Antarctica (Antarctic Treaty area south of 60°S)
origin: The 1959 Antarctic Treaty froze all territorial claims.
on_the_ground: Research stations only; no state border controls; access by expedition.

name: Overlapping Antarctic claims 25°W-80°W
origin: Three claims made 1908-1943 overlap; frozen by the Antarctic Treaty.
on_the_ground: Stations of many states; no claimant exercises control over visitors.

name: Marie Byrd Land (90°W-150°W)
origin: The only Antarctic sector never claimed by any state.
on_the_ground: No permanent station; treaty regime applies.

name: Mazraat Deir al-Ashayer
origin: The Lebanon-Syria boundary was never delimited by treaty; this village area is shown differently on each side's maps.
on_the_ground: Lebanese-administered village.

name: Other unclear sections of the Lebanon-Syria boundary
origin: No treaty describes the boundary; several sections are unclear or disputed.
on_the_ground: Mixed villages and smuggling routes; a demarcation deal was announced in 2025 (not verified).

name: Abu Musa
origin: Iran landed in 1971 under a memorandum with Sharjah and took full control in 1992.
on_the_ground: Iranian garrison and a small civilian population.

name: Greater and Lesser Tunb
origin: Seized by Iran from Ras al-Khaimah in November 1971.
on_the_ground: Iranian military; an airport opened on Greater Tunb in 2022.

name: Bukit Jeli (Kolok River headwaters)
origin: The watershed line under the 1909 treaty is disputed on one short segment left over from the 1973-1990s demarcation.
on_the_ground: Forest hill; no visible difference.

name: Azad Jammu and Kashmir
origin: 1947-1948 war over the princely state; ceasefire line of 1949, Line of Control since 1972.
on_the_ground: Nominally self-governing under Pakistan; foreigners need permits near the LoC.

name: Gilgit-Baltistan
origin: Joined Pakistan after a 1947 revolt against the Maharaja; part of the Kashmir dispute.
on_the_ground: Pakistani administrative territory without full provincial status; open to trekkers.

name: Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh (Indian-administered)
origin: Accession of the Maharaja to India in October 1947; Pakistan claims the state; special status revoked in 2019.
on_the_ground: Two Indian union territories; some border belts need permits.

name: Siachen Glacier and Saltoro Ridge
origin: The 1949 and 1972 lines stopped at point NJ9842 with only the words 'thence north to the glaciers'.
on_the_ground: Indian army posts on the Saltoro Ridge; Pakistani posts below; civilians only as far as base camp on the Indian side.

name: Junagadh and Manavadar
origin: The Nawab acceded to Pakistan in 1947; India took control and held a plebiscite in 1948; Pakistan put it on its official map in 2020.
on_the_ground: Ordinary districts of Gujarat.

name: Sir Creek
origin: 1914 Bombay resolution map: Pakistan reads the border on the east bank, India mid-channel.
on_the_ground: Uninhabited tidal marsh patrolled by border forces.

name: David Gareja monastery complex (Keshikchidag)
origin: Soviet-era republic boundary runs along the ridge through the complex; about a third of the border is undelimited.
on_the_ground: Georgian monks; Azerbaijani border guards restrict the upper cave monasteries since 2019.

name: Doi Lang
origin: Different maps of the 1894 Anglo-Siamese boundary; standoffs since the 1980s.
on_the_ground: Thai and Myanmar army posts face each other on the ridge; birdwatchers visit from the Thai side.

name: Three Pagodas Pass
origin: Small areas around the pass are read differently on colonial maps.
on_the_ground: Border market town; crossing opens and closes with conditions in Myanmar.

name: Fasht ad Dibal and Qit'at Jaradah
origin: ICJ judgment of 2001 gave Qit'at Jaradah to Bahrain and Fasht ad Dibal to Qatar; Wikipedia still lists a residual disagreement.
on_the_ground: Sandbank and low-tide elevation, no presence.

name: Tort-Kocho road (Vorukh access)
origin: The 2025 Kyrgyz-Tajik border treaty declared the roadbed linking the Vorukh exclave to Tajikistan neutral territory.
on_the_ground: A 10 m road with a 15 m security strip belonging to neither side.

name: Kyrgyzstan-Tajikistan border (Batken-Isfara sectors)
origin: Undelimited Soviet-era border caused armed clashes in 2021 and 2022; delimitation agreed 21 February 2025 and a border treaty followed in March 2025.
on_the_ground: Crossings reopened in 2025; Tajik exclave Vorukh remains.

name: Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan border (Kempir-Abad, Ungar-Too, Barak)
origin: Delimitation treaty ratified November 2022, demarcation approved 2023; the Barak enclave was absorbed by Uzbekistan in April 2024.
on_the_ground: Uzbek exclaves Sokh and Shohimardon remain as agreed enclaves, not disputes.

name: Golan Heights
origin: Captured by Israel in 1967; Israeli law applied in 1981; annexation recognised only by the United States (2019).
on_the_ground: Run as ordinary Israeli territory; entered freely from Israel.

name: UNDOF area of separation
origin: Created by the 1974 disengagement agreement; Israel declared the agreement void and moved in on 8 December 2024.
on_the_ground: Israeli army controls it; UNDOF remains in place and calls the IDF the de facto authority.

name: Israeli-held positions in southern Syria beyond the 1974 zone (incl. Mount Hermon summit)
origin: Israel advanced beyond the buffer zone after the fall of the Assad government in December 2024.
on_the_ground: Israeli military posts; Israel says it will stay indefinitely.

name: Shebaa Farms and Kfarchouba hills
parties: Israel (controls); Lebanon (claims); Syria (UN regards as Syrian)
origin: Taken by Israel with the Golan in 1967; Lebanon has claimed it since Israel's withdrawal from Lebanon in 2000.
on_the_ground: Israeli military zone on the slopes of Mount Hermon.

name: Ghajar (northern part)
parties: Israel (controls); Lebanon (north of the Blue Line)
origin: The 2000 UN Blue Line cuts the village; Israel reoccupied the northern half in 2006.
on_the_ground: Alawite village run from Israel; opened to visitors in 2022.

name: Israeli-held points in south Lebanon
origin: Israel kept five hilltop positions inside Lebanon after the February 2025 withdrawal deadline; current extent not verified.
on_the_ground: Israeli army outposts.

name: West Bank
parties: Israel (occupies; Area C direct control); Palestine (claims; PA administers Areas A and B)
origin: Captured from Jordan in 1967; Oslo II (1995) split it into Areas A, B and C.
on_the_ground: Israeli checkpoints and settlements; Palestinian Authority cities; entry only via Israeli-controlled crossings.

name: East Jerusalem
origin: Captured in 1967 and placed under Israeli law; Basic Law of 1980.
on_the_ground: Run as part of Israeli Jerusalem.

name: 1949 no-man's-lands (Latrun, Jerusalem) and Mount Scopus enclave
origin: Zones left between the lines by the 1949 Israel-Jordan armistice; under Israeli control since 1967.
on_the_ground: Indistinguishable from Israel on the ground (a highway crosses Latrun).

name: Gaza Strip
parties: Israel (military control of part since 2023-2025); Hamas / Palestinian bodies; Palestine (claims)
origin: Occupied 1967; Israeli withdrawal 2005; war from October 2023; October 2025 ceasefire left Israeli forces behind a 'yellow line'.
on_the_ground: Devastated war zone; no ordinary entry.

name: Kalapani, Lipulekh and Limpiyadhura
origin: Dispute over which stream is the Kali River of the 1816 Sugauli Treaty; both issued rival maps in 2019-2020.
on_the_ground: Indian border posts and a road to Lipulekh pass; a few villages; permits required.

name: Susta
origin: The Gandak (Narayani) River boundary shifted course after 1816.
on_the_ground: Farming settlement cut off by the river.

name: Humla border area (Limi/Lapcha)
origin: Reports in 2020-2021 that China built structures on the Nepali side of the agreed line; China denies.
on_the_ground: Remote high valley.

name: Artsvashen (Bashkend)
origin: Armenian exclave inside Azerbaijan taken by Azerbaijani forces in 1992.
on_the_ground: Resettled by Azerbaijanis; unreachable from Armenia.

name: Karki (Tigranashen)
origin: Azerbaijani (Nakhchivan) exclave taken by Armenia in 1990-1992.
on_the_ground: Armenian village on the main Yerevan-Goris road.

name: Barkhudarli, Sofulu and Yukhari Askipara
origin: Azerbaijani exclaves inside Armenia taken in the early 1990s.
on_the_ground: Ruined villages near Armenian roads; military presence.

name: Border heights inside Armenia held by Azerbaijan since 2021-2022
origin: Azerbaijani advances in May 2021 and September 2022 across the undelimited border.
on_the_ground: Military positions on ridges near Jermuk and Lake Sev.

name: Four non-enclave Gazakh villages (Baghanis Ayrum, Ashagi Askipara, Kheyrimli, Gizilhajili)
origin: Held by Armenia since the early 1990s; returned to Azerbaijan in April-May 2024 with the first agreed border delimitation.
on_the_ground: New demarcated border section in Tavush.

name: Nagorno-Karabakh (former Republic of Artsakh)
origin: De facto state from 1991; Azerbaijan retook it in 2020 and September 2023; Artsakh dissolved on 1 January 2024.
on_the_ground: Azerbaijani territory, almost all Armenians left; visits by Azerbaijani permit.

name: North Korea (claimed by the Republic of Korea)
parties: North Korea (administers); South Korea (constitutional claim to the whole peninsula)
origin: Division of Korea in 1945 and two states in 1948; South Korea's constitution covers the whole peninsula.
on_the_ground: A separate UN member state.

name: South Korea (formerly claimed by North Korea)
origin: Wikipedia reports that North Korea recognised the Republic of Korea and dropped its claim in 2026 (not independently verified).
on_the_ground: A separate UN member state.

name: Korean Demilitarized Zone
parties: North Korea; South Korea; UN Command
origin: 1953 Armistice Agreement set a 4 km wide zone along the Military Demarcation Line.
on_the_ground: Fenced and mined; two villages inside; visits only on escorted tours to the JSA and observation points.

name: Southern Kuril Islands (Iturup, Kunashir, Shikotan, Habomai)
origin: Occupied by the Soviet Union in August-September 1945; Japan claims them as its Northern Territories.
on_the_ground: Ordinary Russian districts of Sakhalin Oblast inside a border zone needing a permit.

name: Liancourt Rocks (Dokdo / Takeshima)
origin: Japan incorporated them in 1905; South Korea has held them since 1954.
on_the_ground: Korean police garrison; day-trip ferries from Ulleungdo.

name: Islands in the Mekong
origin: 1926 Franco-Siamese convention assigns islands by channel; demarcation of the river boundary is incomplete.
on_the_ground: River islands farmed seasonally.

name: Ban Romklao and the three villages (Ban Mai, Ban Klang, Ban Sawang)
origin: Different readings of the 1907 treaty watershed; border war in 1987-1988.
on_the_ground: Thai-administered villages; demarcation stalled.

name: Noktundo
parties: Russia (administers); South Korea (does not accept the 1990 USSR-DPRK treaty)
origin: Former island on the Tumen ceded to Russia in 1860; confirmed Russian by the 1990 Soviet-North Korean treaty.
on_the_ground: Empty marshland in a Russian border zone.

name: 'Point 20' reclaimed land at Tuas
origin: Malaysia said the reclamation lay in its waters; ITLOS case 2003 and a settlement agreement in 2005.
on_the_ground: Industrial reclaimed land.

name: O'Tangav area
origin: About 14 per cent of the boundary is undemarcated; standoffs in 2017 and 2019.
on_the_ground: Forest area with troops of both sides withdrawn by agreement.

name: Preah Vihear temple surroundings
origin: ICJ gave the temple (1962) and the promontory (2013) to Cambodia; adjacent land is still contested between the Annex I map and the watershed.
on_the_ground: Temple reached from Cambodia; the border has been closed since the 2025 fighting.

name: Other contested Thai-Cambodian border areas (Ta Muen Thom, Ta Krabey, Emerald Triangle/Chong Bok)
origin: Undemarcated sections under the 1904-1907 treaties; armed conflict in July and December 2025 during which Thai forces took several positions.
on_the_ground: Militarised; border crossings closed since 2025.

name: Eastern Sabah (North Borneo)
origin: Philippines claims as successor of the Sultanate of Sulu, arguing the 1878 grant was a lease; Sabah joined Malaysia in 1963.
on_the_ground: Ordinary Malaysian state with its own immigration control.

name: Saudi Arabia-UAE border (Khor al-Udaid corridor, Shaybah/Zararah area)
parties: Saudi Arabia (administers per 1974 Treaty of Jeddah); United Arab Emirates (contests the treaty text)
origin: The UAE says the 1974 treaty text differs from what was agreed orally and has never ratified it; UAE maps showed the old line again from 2006.
on_the_ground: Saudi Arabia controls the coastal corridor between Qatar and the UAE.

name: Ukatny, Zhestky and Maly Zhemchuzhny islands
origin: Islets in the northern Caspian near oil structures; Wikipedia lists the dispute as open (not verified).
on_the_ground: Uninhabited sandbanks.

name: Citrana Triangle (Naktuka) and other unresolved Oecusse segments
origin: 1904 Dutch-Portuguese treaty names the mouth of the Noel Besi, whose course both sides read differently.
on_the_ground: Farmland settled by Timorese families; meant to stay unsettled pending agreement.

name: Legacy claims of the Republic of China (mainland China, Mongolia, Tuva, Pamirs, northern Myanmar, parts of Bhutan, India, Russia and others)
parties: Various administering states; Republic of China (Taiwan) constitutional claim, not actively pursued
origin: The ROC never formally renounced the pre-1949 boundaries or recognised border treaties made by the PRC.
on_the_ground: No effect on the ground.

name: Aksai Chin
origin: Never delimited by treaty; China built a road in the 1950s and kept the area after the 1962 war.
on_the_ground: Uninhabited Chinese military plateau crossed by highway G219.

name: Eastern Ladakh LAC friction areas (Depsang, Galwan, Pangong north bank, Gogra-Hot Springs)
origin: After the 2020 clashes both armies pulled back from several points, creating no-patrol buffer strips; a 2024 patrolling deal covered Depsang and Demchok.
on_the_ground: Military-only strips where neither side patrols or grazes.

name: Demchok sector
parties: India (Demchok village); China (Dêmqog); each claims the whole
origin: The Line of Actual Control splits the sector along the Charding Nullah; no treaty line.
on_the_ground: Villages on both sides; inner-line permit on the Indian side.

name: Middle sector pockets (Chumar, Kaurik, Shipki La, Nelang-Jadhang, Barahoti, Lapthal, Pulam Sumda, Sang)
origin: Different readings of the watershed in the least disputed sector of the India-China frontier; no treaty line.
on_the_ground: High pastures and passes with Indian border posts.

name: Arunachal Pradesh
origin: China rejects the 1914 McMahon Line; war in 1962.
on_the_ground: Ordinary Indian state requiring a Protected Area Permit for foreigners.

name: Trans-Karakoram Tract (Shaksgam Valley)
origin: Recognised as Chinese by Pakistan in the 1963 boundary agreement, which India rejects.
on_the_ground: Uninhabited valleys north of K2; Chinese permits for expeditions.

name: Jakarlung, Pasamlung and Beyul Khenpajong
origin: No boundary treaty exists; talks since 1984; China has built villages in the area since about 2016.
on_the_ground: Chinese-built villages and roads; no Bhutanese administration.

name: Doklam, Dramana, Shakhatoe, Sinchulung and western Haa
origin: No boundary treaty; the 2017 India-China standoff took place at Doklam.
on_the_ground: Chinese military infrastructure on the plateau; Bhutanese army posts nearby.

name: Kula Kangri area
parties: China (controls); Bhutan (formerly shown on Bhutanese maps)
origin: Undelimited northern boundary; the peak dropped off Bhutanese maps in the 2000s.
on_the_ground: High mountain area under Chinese control.

name: Sakteng Wildlife Sanctuary
origin: China raised a claim for the first time at a 2020 environmental funding meeting.
on_the_ground: Ordinary eastern Bhutan district with no Chinese border.

name: Former Bhutanese enclaves in western Tibet (Darchen, Khochar and others)
origin: Bhutan administered several enclaves near Mount Kailash until China took them over in 1959.
on_the_ground: Ordinary Chinese-administered Tibetan villages.

name: Senkaku Islands (Diaoyu)
origin: Incorporated by Japan in 1895; claims by China and Taiwan since 1971 after oil surveys.
on_the_ground: Uninhabited; landing prohibited by Japan; coast guard patrols.

name: Paracel Islands
origin: China took the western group from South Vietnam in 1974.
on_the_ground: Chinese city of Sansha on Woody Island; tours for Chinese citizens only.

name: Spratly Islands
parties: China; Taiwan; Vietnam; Philippines; Malaysia (each holds features); Brunei (claim)
origin: Occupations from 1946 to the 1990s; Chinese island-building from 2013; 2016 arbitral award rejected by China.
on_the_ground: Garrisons of five governments; civilians on Thitu; a Malaysian dive resort on Swallow Reef.

name: Scarborough Shoal
origin: Standoff in 2012 left China in control.
on_the_ground: A few rocks above water; Chinese coast guard blocks access.

name: Taiwan and Penghu
parties: Republic of China (governs); People's Republic of China (claims)
origin: The ROC government moved to Taiwan in 1949; the PRC claims it as a province.
on_the_ground: Fully separate government, visas and border control.

name: Kinmen, Matsu and Wuqiu
parties: Republic of China (governs); People's Republic of China (claims)
origin: Offshore islands of Fujian held by the ROC after 1949.
on_the_ground: Part of Taiwan's immigration area; ferries to the mainland.

name: Pratas (Dongsha) Island
parties: Republic of China (governs); People's Republic of China (claims)
origin: Held by the ROC since 1946.
on_the_ground: Coast guard garrison and national park; no tourism.

name: Islands in the Yalu and Tumen rivers
parties: China; North Korea (South Korea and ROC do not recognise the 1962 treaty)
origin: Allocated by the secret 1962 China-DPRK border treaty; the Factbook still lists some as disputed.
on_the_ground: River islands, mostly North Korean-held.

name: Durand Line
parties: Pakistan (administers its side); Afghanistan (does not recognise the line)
origin: The 1893 Durand agreement line was rejected by Afghan governments from 1947.
on_the_ground: Pakistan has fenced most of it; crossings at Torkham and Chaman open and close with tensions.

name: India-Bangladesh enclaves and adverse possessions
origin: 1974 Land Boundary Agreement implemented on 31 July 2015, exchanging 162 enclaves.
on_the_ground: Ordinary territory of each state now.

name: Tin Bigha Corridor (Dahagram-Angarpota access)
origin: Corridor leased under the 1974 agreement; open 24 hours since 2011.
on_the_ground: Short fenced road across Indian territory guarded by Indian border forces.

name: Pedra Branca, Middle Rocks and South Ledge
origin: ICJ 2008 gave Pedra Branca to Singapore and Middle Rocks to Malaysia; Malaysia dropped its revision request in 2018.
on_the_ground: Lighthouse rock closed to visitors.

name: Tiran and Sanafir
origin: Egypt administered them from 1950; 2016 agreement ratified in 2017 returned them to Saudi Arabia.
on_the_ground: Uninhabited; multinational observers present under the 1979 treaty arrangements.

name: Saudi-Kuwaiti neutral zone, Qaruh and Umm al Maradim
origin: Zone partitioned in 1970; remaining disagreements settled by a December 2019 agreement.
on_the_ground: Ordinary border area with shared oil operations.

name: Hatay Province
origin: Annexed by Turkey in 1939; Wikipedia treats the Syrian claim as dropped after the change of government in 2024 (implied, not verified).
on_the_ground: Ordinary Turkish province.

name: Baqoura (Naharayim) and Al-Ghamr (Tzofar)
origin: The 1994 peace treaty gave Israeli farmers a 25-year special regime on Jordanian land; Jordan ended it on 10 November 2019.
on_the_ground: Ordinary Jordanian territory now.

name: Tomb of Suleyman Shah
origin: Article 9 of the 1921 Treaty of Ankara left the tomb as Turkish property with a Turkish guard; moved to Ashme near the border in 2015.
on_the_ground: Turkish military guard post inside Syria.

name: Baikonur Cosmodrome and city
origin: Leased by Russia since 1994; lease extended to 2050.
on_the_ground: City run under Russian law with Russian currency in use; entry by permit or organised tour.

name: Russian-leased military test ranges in Kazakhstan (Sary-Shagan and others)
origin: Leased under 1990s bilateral agreements.
on_the_ground: Closed military areas.

name: Crimea and Sevastopol
origin: Seized and annexed by Russia in February-March 2014; UNGA resolution 68/262 affirms Ukraine's territorial integrity.
on_the_ground: Run as Russian federal subjects; reachable only from Russia; entry violates Ukrainian law.

name: Russian-occupied Donetsk Oblast
origin: Partly held by Russian proxies from 2014; annexation declared 30 September 2022.
on_the_ground: Russian administration behind an active front line.

name: Russian-occupied Luhansk Oblast
origin: Partly held by Russian proxies from 2014; annexation declared 30 September 2022.
on_the_ground: Russian administration.

name: Russian-occupied Zaporizhzhia Oblast
origin: Occupied in 2022; annexation declared 30 September 2022.
on_the_ground: Russian administration behind an active front line.

name: Russian-occupied Kherson Oblast (left bank) and Kinburn Spit
parties: Russia (controls left bank, claims all incl. Snihurivka area); Ukraine
origin: Occupied in 2022; annexation declared 30 September 2022; right bank retaken by Ukraine in November 2022.
on_the_ground: Russian administration; the Dnipro is the front line.

name: Ivangorod (Jaanilinn) and Pechory district (Petserimaa)
parties: Russia (administers); Estonia (no official claim; border treaty unratified)
origin: Assigned to Estonia by the 1920 Treaty of Tartu and transferred to the Russian SFSR in 1944-1945; the 2014 border treaty is still unratified.
on_the_ground: Ordinary Russian territory along a demarcated control line.

name: Imia / Kardak
origin: Military crisis in 1996 over two uninhabited islets; part of the wider Aegean 'grey zones' dispute.
on_the_ground: No presence by agreement; coast guard patrols.

name: Akrotiri and Dhekelia Sovereign Base Areas
origin: Retained by the UK under the 1960 Treaty of Establishment.
on_the_ground: British military administration; Cypriot villages and roads inside are open with no border checks.

name: UN Buffer Zone in Cyprus
origin: Ceasefire lines of August 1974.
on_the_ground: UN-patrolled strip with a few inhabited villages (Pyla) and nine crossing points; elsewhere entry needs UN permission.

name: Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus
parties: Northern Cyprus (self-governing, recognised only by Turkey); Cyprus (claims)
origin: Turkish invasion in 1974; independence declared in 1983.
on_the_ground: Own administration and border checks at the Green Line crossings.

name: Kokkina (Erenköy) exclave
origin: Turkish Cypriot enclave held since 1964, separated from the rest of the north.
on_the_ground: Turkish military post with no civilians.

name: Strovilia checkpoint area
parties: Northern Cyprus (controls since 2000); Cyprus; United Kingdom (SBA boundary)
origin: Turkish forces moved their checkpoint forward in 2000 next to the Dhekelia base boundary.
on_the_ground: A crossing point into the north.

name: Varosha (Maraş)
parties: Turkish army / Northern Cyprus (controls); Cyprus (claims); UN resolutions call for UN administration
origin: Fenced off by the Turkish army in 1974; UNSC resolutions 550 and 789; part reopened to visitors in October 2020.
on_the_ground: Abandoned resort district under military control with a visitor route.

name: Abkhazia
parties: Abkhazia (self-governing, recognised by Russia and a few states); Georgia (claims)
origin: War of 1992-1993; Russian recognition in 2008.
on_the_ground: Own administration with Russian border guards; entry from Russia breaks Georgian law.

name: South Ossetia
parties: South Ossetia (self-governing, recognised by Russia and a few states); Georgia (claims)
origin: War of 1991-1992; Russian recognition after the 2008 war.
on_the_ground: Reachable only from Russia by permit; fenced boundary line with Georgia.

name: Truso Gorge, Ghuda Gorge and Kobi Plateau
origin: South Ossetian claim voiced since 2008 to 'historically Ossetian lands'.
on_the_ground: Georgian border zone in Kazbegi municipality; the gorge needs a border police permit.

name: Transnistria (including Bender)
origin: War of 1992; Russian troops remain.
on_the_ground: Own administration, currency and entry registration.

name: Moldovan-controlled Dubăsari villages, Varnița and Copanca
origin: Left under Moldovan control by the 1992 ceasefire.
on_the_ground: Ordinary Moldovan villages reached through or beside Transnistrian checkpoints.

name: Dniester Security Zone
origin: Created by the July 1992 ceasefire agreement; 225 km long and 1-15 km wide.
on_the_ground: Peacekeeper checkpoints on roads and bridges; otherwise normal life.

name: Kosovo
parties: Kosovo (self-governing, recognised by about 100 UN members); Serbia (claims)
origin: UN administration from 1999; independence declared 17 February 2008.
on_the_ground: Own government and border control; Serbia treats entry via Kosovo as irregular.

name: Kosovo-Montenegro border (Čakor, Kula)
origin: Demarcation agreement of 2015 ratified by Kosovo in March 2018; Serbia does not recognise it.
on_the_ground: Mountain pastures.

name: Mont Blanc summit area (Dôme du Goûter, Col du Géant)
origin: Different readings of the 1860 Treaty of Turin maps: France draws the border south of the summit, Italy on the watershed.
on_the_ground: Glaciers and a French-run refuge; climbed freely.

name: Gibraltar
origin: Ceded by the 1713 Treaty of Utrecht; Spain also contests the isthmus, which the treaty did not mention.
on_the_ground: Self-governing UK territory; a 2025 UK-EU deal foresees removing the land border checks.

name: Rockall
parties: United Kingdom (claims, annexed 1955); Ireland, Denmark, Iceland (contest its maritime effect)
origin: Annexed by the UK in 1955 and by statute in 1972; Ireland does not recognise the claim.
on_the_ground: Uninhabitable rock.

name: Olivenza and Táliga
parties: Spain (administers); Portugal (does not recognise Spanish sovereignty)
origin: Ceded to Spain by the 1801 Treaty of Badajoz; Portugal relies on the 1815 Vienna Final Act; the border there is undelimited.
on_the_ground: Ordinary Spanish municipalities on an open Schengen border.

name: Danube east-bank pockets (Bačka) claimed by Croatia
origin: Croatia follows 19th-century cadastral boundaries, Serbia the present course of the Danube.
on_the_ground: Forest and farmland under Serbian control.

name: Islands of Šarengrad and Vukovar
origin: Occupied in 1991 and kept by Serbia after 1998 under its river-thalweg position.
on_the_ground: River islands; a beach on Vukovar Island is open to Croatian visitors by a 2006 arrangement.

name: Gornja Siga and other west-bank pockets
parties: Croatia (de facto control, attributes it to Serbia); Serbia (no claim)
origin: Left unclaimed by the two states' incompatible boundary rules; site of the 2015 'Liberland' micronation.
on_the_ground: Forest patrolled by Croatian police, who remove visitors.

name: Sveta Gera (Trdinov vrh) barracks
origin: Yugoslav army barracks taken over by Slovenia in 1991 on land Croatia's cadastre counts as Croatian.
on_the_ground: Small Slovenian army post on a hiking summit.

name: Dragonja left-bank hamlets and other Slovenia-Croatia segments
origin: A 2017 arbitral award (accepted by Slovenia, rejected by Croatia) left the hamlets with Croatia.
on_the_ground: Croatian-administered hamlets; both states are in Schengen since 2023.

name: Sections along the Drina
origin: River course shifts, hydropower plants and a railway section; about half the boundary is delimited.
on_the_ground: No visible difference.

name: Mali Školj, Veliki Školj and the tip of Klek
origin: The 1999 border treaty gave them to Bosnia but was never ratified by Croatia.
on_the_ground: Uninhabited islets and headland near Neum.

name: River island at Kostajnica (Zrinski castle)
origin: Una River boundary under the unratified 1999 treaty.
on_the_ground: Castle and shared border crossing in use since 2003.

name: Prevlaka peninsula
origin: UN observer mission until 2002; a 2002 interim protocol demilitarised the area pending a final settlement.
on_the_ground: Croatian land open as a park; joint police patrol at sea.

name: Sutorina
origin: Bosnian claim to the coastal strip dropped in the August 2015 border treaty.
on_the_ground: Ordinary Montenegrin territory.

name: Lake Constance (Obersee)
origin: No treaty fixes the border in the main lake; Switzerland assumes a median line, Austria a condominium.
on_the_ground: Water only; no checks or visible effect.

name: Germany-Luxembourg river condominium (Moselle, Sauer, Our)
origin: Joint sovereignty over the rivers set by the 1816 Treaty of Aachen and confirmed in 1984.
on_the_ground: Rivers, bridges and about 15 islets under shared sovereignty; no checks.

name: Pheasant Island
origin: Condominium under the 1659 Treaty of the Pyrenees.
on_the_ground: Uninhabited river islet closed to the public except on rare open days.

name: Svalbard
parties: Norway (sovereign under the 1920 Svalbard Treaty); treaty parties have equal economic access
origin: The 1920 treaty recognised Norwegian sovereignty with demilitarisation and equal rights for nationals of the parties.
on_the_ground: Outside Schengen and visa-free for all; a Russian mining settlement operates at Barentsburg.

name: Saimaa Canal (Russian section)
origin: Leased under 1963 and 2010 treaties for 50 years.
on_the_ground: Canal zone inside Russia managed by Finland; traffic suspended since 2022.

name: Moldauhafen and Saalehafen (Hamburg)
origin: 99-year lease from 1929 under the Treaty of Versailles; expires in 2028.
on_the_ground: Largely disused port lots in Hamburg's free port area.

name: Odesa-Reni road section at Palanca
origin: Under the 1999 Moldova-Ukraine border treaty Ukraine owns a 7.7 km road section crossing Moldovan territory.
on_the_ground: Ukrainian transit road through Moldova without Moldovan checks.

name: Matthew and Hunter Islands
origin: Attached to New Caledonia by France in 1976; claimed by Vanuatu since independence in 1980.
on_the_ground: Uninhabited volcanic islets; an automatic weather station.

name: Minerva Reefs
origin: Tonga annexed the reefs in 1972 after a micronation attempt; Fiji objected in 2005 and destroyed beacons in 2011.
on_the_ground: Reefs awash at high tide used as a yacht anchorage.

name: Swains Island (Olohega)
origin: Annexed to American Samoa in 1925; the 1980 Treaty of Tokehega confirmed US title but Tokelau's 2006 draft constitution claims it.
on_the_ground: Privately owned atoll with no permanent population at present.

name: Wake Island
origin: Annexed by the US in 1899; the Marshall Islands restated its claim to the UN in 2016.
on_the_ground: US Air Force installation with no public access.
